purpose: Non-comparative capability and runner-feasibility calibration on a hidden-information collaboration task; no language superiority test.
research_question: Can a locally feasible Qwen3-14B CRAFT team make measurable construction progress when each of the three distinct private-view Directors contributes one message per turn and the Builder receives all three?

source.adapter_change: Replace three with-replacement Director calls with a seeded sample of D1, D2, D3 without replacement. Preserve simultaneous round semantics: every Director reads the same pre-round conversation snapshot; Builder receives the one response stored for each role.

model.runtime: llama.cpp b11202 OpenAI-compatible server, 24 GPU layers, context 8192, reasoning disabled, temp 0 server default; upstream Director temp 0.7/max_tokens 500, Builder temp 0.1/max_tokens 250

design.structure_selection: fixed spread across the 20-structure evaluation set; report actual ids and complexity from the source data
design.communication_condition: upstream CRAFT natural-language prompts and messages; corrected one-message-per-distinct-role delivery adapter
design.inference_budget: At most 60 scored completions: 3 structures × 5 turns × (3 Director + 1 Builder). Stop a game if the upstream runner stops it earlier. No retry after a model call; preserve any partial trace.

outcomes.primary: upstream final_progress and completed fields, reported per structure and as an unweighted mean across the three structures
secondary: count of generated Director messages and Builder-delivered messages (must match at three per completed turn)
failed/invalid Builder moves and parse or backend errors
not_measured: exact model token usage or total inference FLOPs
generalization beyond the three selected structures

predictions: The no-replacement adapter will produce three distinct Director roles and three corresponding Builder-visible messages on every completed turn.

At least one of the three structures will show nonzero progress by turn five; if none do, do not proceed to a message-format comparison on this model/task configuration without revisiting task or model capability.
analysis_plan: Publish all three structure outcomes, including zeros and errors. Verify transcript message counts mechanically. Do not exclude failed calls or turns from task-success denominators. This is a feasibility gate, not a ranking.
